selection_rule: Compare context modes at identical budgets; prefer development candidate-pool gates, then pool evidence, then selected evidence, then smaller candidate allocation. Report final Top5 losses and exposed split regressions; do not automatically promote production or claim unseen validation.
invariants: Identical body chunks, order and evidence grading
Separate fresh isolated index per context mode
Context labels only from document metadata and source headings
No query expansion, reranking, model or generation changes
limitations: Assistant-authored synthetic data with correlated templates
All validation questions previously measured and exposed
Single serial timing; no production latency claims
